name: Cledara
summary: Cledara combines a software directory with company cards and spend control. It builds one list of every tool a company pays for, shows seat use per app, and flags renewals ahead of time. It is one of the few products here with published prices, and they are in pounds sterling.

facts.text: Cledara says it builds one live list of every tool a company pays for, including unapproved ones, and shows one example of a tool found on an expense claim.
Cledara says its application list shows seat use per tool and that it flags a renewal in advance with a reminder before each one.
Cledara states that it is SOC 2 Type II certified and compliant with GDPR. It claims no ISO 27001 certification of its own.
Annual billing saves 16%, which Cledara describes as two months free.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: £2,000 a year when billed yearly. Includes 10 active members and 1% cashback in year one, capped at the plan price.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: From £500 a month or £5,000 a year. Includes 50 active members in a tailored package.

hiddenCosts: Additional active members on Cledara Spend cost £5 per month each.
Add-ons cost extra on any plan: Spend Optimisation, IT Management and Software Compliance are £150 a month each, and each Cledara Agent is £200 a month.

contract.cancellation: The pricing page says a plan can be cancelled at any time from the Billing section in Settings.
